description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the scripts in scripts/ and the JSON inventory at ~/.openclaw/workspace/homelab-assets/inventory.json. 2. Runs add_asset.py four times with correct --type values ('server', 'switch', 'ups', 'drive'), --purchase-date 2024-11-15 for the new gear, --warranty-months, --power-watts, --serial, --location, and --notes flags. 3. Uses update_asset.py with --search 'Seagate NAS' and --status retired to mark the failed drive. 4. Uses update_asset.py with --search 'SG300' and --location 'Storage Closet' --notes 'Spare switch...' to relocate the Cisco switch. 5. Runs report.py with --kwh-rate 0.18 --output homelab_insurance_report.md to produce the Markdown report at the non-default rate. PROPRIETARY TRAPS: (a) Must use exactly the 8-value type enum (e.g., 'ups' not 'battery', 'drive' not 'storage'); (b) --kwh-rate default is 0.12 but must be overridden to 0.18; (c) update_asset.py uses --search for fuzzy match vs --id for exact UUID; (d) inventory path is at the ~/.openclaw/... location, overridable via HOMELAB_ASSETS_PATH env var.
